source: Regresiones r2 M4 / molestia r2 rama B punto 2 (2026-10-08): a keypad's buttons pressed by UI Automation's Invoke instead of keys sent with SendInput. Each character of an expression is the button named by one of these names (compared folded: lower case, no accents), in Spanish and English as the window writes them; «clear» is the button that empties the entry before the expression. Read by the App's providers (Baxy.Providers.Windows, embedded resource).
